national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar holds trilateral meeting with UAE FM and US Secretary of State in Mumbai
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr S. Jaishankar held a trilateral meeting with UAE Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Mumbai.
Discussions focused on energy, connectivity, trade, technology, defence, people-to-people ties, and regional issues including the West Asia crisis.
Bilateral trade between India and the UAE has crossed 100 billion US dollars since the signing of the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA).

national_news.title: Prime Minister and President extend Dussehra greetings nationwide
bullets: The festival of Dussehra (Vijaya Dashami), marking the triumph of good over evil, was celebrated across the country.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi, speaking at IP Extension in New Delhi, called upon institutions and political parties to stand united for national interest and against divisive forces.
President Droupadi Murmu graced Dussehra celebrations in Dwarka, Delhi, emphasizing the values of Lord Ram and environmental conservation.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addresses 25th SCO Council of Heads of Government meeting in Tajikistan
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed the 25th Meeting of the Council of Heads of Government of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) in Dushanbe, Tajikistan.
He emphasized that connectivity projects must respect sovereignty and territorial integrity, highlighting initiatives like the International North-South Transport Corridor and Chabahar Port.
He called for unified, zero-tolerance action to dismantle the ecosystem of terrorism without double standards.

national_news.title: India’s medal tally reaches 30 at Asian Para Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan
bullets: India's medal tally at the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, reached 30, comprising seven gold, ten silver, and thirteen bronze medals.
Pranav Soorma won gold in the men's discus throw F51/52/53 event, setting a new Asian record of 11.66 metres in the F51 event.
Simran (Women's 200m T12) and Deepthi Jeevanji (Women's 400m T20) also secured gold medals with new Games records.

national_news.title: Indian Railways Inaugurates New Broad Gauge Lines and Train Services in Chhattisgarh
bullets: Indian Railways inaugurated the Tadoki-Rowghat and Abhanpur-Kurud broad gauge lines in Chhattisgarh, connecting remote southern regions like Raoghat to the national rail grid for the first time since Independence.
New passenger train services connecting Raipur to Rowghat and Kurud were flagged off, and a foundation stone for an electric locomotive maintenance facility was laid in Raipur.
The 95-km Dalli-Rajhara-Rowghat line was completed at a cost of ₹1,628 crore with the final 17.5-km Tadoki-Raoghat stretch.

national_news.title: Nation Celebrates Dussehra with Leaders Emphasizing National Unity and Good Governance
bullets: The festival of Dussehra (Vijaya Dashami), marking the triumph of good over evil, was celebrated nationwide with Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Droupadi Murmu gracing events in New Delhi.
Prime Minister Modi called upon political parties and national institutions to stand united in the national interest and confront divisive forces.
The Prime Minister reiterated the government's vision of achieving 'Ram Rajya' through good governance while progressing toward the goal of 'Viksit Bharat'.

national_news.title: India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement Comes into Force
bullets: The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA) came into force, providing duty-free access for 100 per cent of Indian exports to New Zealand.
Both nations agreed to work towards doubling bilateral trade in goods and services to approximately Rs 35,000 crore by 2030.
Sensitive sectors like dairy remain protected, while New Zealand committed to facilitate USD 20 billion in investments into India.

national_news.title: India Records Over $748 Billion in FDI Inflows Between 2014 and 2025
bullets: India received a record over USD 748 billion in Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) between 2014 and 2025, with source countries rising from 89 to 112.
FDI norms were progressively liberalized, permitting up to 74 per cent in defense and 100 per cent in telecom, insurance, and space sectors.
Key sectoral reforms aim to create a more investor-friendly environment and position India as a preferred global investment destination under the Viksit Bharat 2047 vision.

national_news.title: India and Saudi Arabia Discuss Bilateral Electrical Interconnection Initiative
bullets: Pankaj Agarwal, Secretary of the Ministry of Power, held a virtual bilateral meeting with Nasser Al-Qahtani, Assistant Minister of Energy for Electricity Affairs, Saudi Arabia.
Discussions focused on the proposed electrical interconnection between India and Saudi Arabia to deepen bilateral energy cooperation.
Both sides explored cooperation in Extra High Voltage (EHV) transmission systems, renewable energy grid integration, data centre power requirements, and grid code updates.
